title: p NULL POINTS NOT 1. Elements on PLANES of real/imaginary/mechanical/unreal. Intersection = lines = nodes = dimensionality.

the_problem.screenshot: Everything is ON the HUD. The sphere, primals, chipmunk, infra, culture, discovery — all on ONE z-plane. Flat. No separation between planes. No intersection structure.
the_problem.result: No lines (where planes cross). No nodes (where lines cross). No dimensionality. Just dots on glass. The crystal ball is flat.
the_problem.one_null: Currently 1 null point at the center of the sphere. One center. One origin. That flattens everything — all elements are equidistant from ONE point. That's a circle, not a structure.

the_fix.planes_not_points: Put elements on different PLANES. Each plane corresponds to a quaternion axis pair. Where planes intersect ? lines appear. Where lines intersect ? nodes appear. The structure emerges from intersection, not position.

REAL_PLANE.tilt: horizontal — the table surface. The ground plane. Earth.
REAL_PLANE.in_hud: The base layer. Infrastructure. The things that exist materially.

IMAGINARY_PLANE.tilt: vertical, facing you — the mirror. The glass. The fold visible edge-on.
IMAGINARY_PLANE.in_hud: The fold layer. Perpendicular to real plane. Cuts through the crystal ball vertically.

MECHANICAL_PLANE.tilt: 45° between real and imaginary — the gear plane. Where mechanism intersects matter.
MECHANICAL_PLANE.in_hud: The machine layer. Angled through the crystal ball at 45°. The squirrel's 45/p observation angle.

UNREAL_PLANE.tilt: 45° tilted toward you — the storybook angled for reading. The campfire glow plane.
UNREAL_PLANE.in_hud: The narrative layer. Angled through the crystal ball at 45° opposite to mechanical.

intersections.where_planes_cross: 4 planes in 3D space create 6 intersection LINES (each pair crosses once)

lines.line: the HORIZON — where ground meets mirror. The edge of the roundtable where you look into the ball.
the AXLE — where material meets machine. The drive shaft. The assembly line.
the CAMPFIRE — where ground meets story. The fireside. Where real events become narrative.
the PENDULUM — where fold meets machine. The escapement. The 3.14159s swing.
the DREAM — where fold meets story. The lucid dream. The Klein narrative.
the SHADOW — where machine meets story. The ghost in the machine. The null-shadow cast by moonlight on narrative.

intersections.nodes_where_lines_cross: 6 lines in 3D can create up to 15 intersection points. But our 4 planes share a common center (the crystal ball) so many lines converge there. The DISTRIBUTED null points are where lines cross AWAY from center.

pi_null_points.why_not_one: One null point = one center = everything equidistant = circle = flat. p null points = distributed fold = structure.
pi_null_points.why_pi: p is the ratio of circumference to diameter. On the ouroboros (a circle), the null point appears at every p radians — which is halfway around. But p is IRRATIONAL — the null points never exactly repeat. They PRECESS. Each cycle shifts the null by 0.14159... — the remainder. The null drifts.

the_pi_nulls.what: Where real plane meets imaginary plane. The main fold. The horizon line.
the_pi_nulls.where_in_hud: Top of crystal ball. Where the sphere touches the nav bar.
the_pi_nulls.type: primary — the fold null. Where a becomes bi.

the_pi_nulls.what: Where mechanical plane meets unreal plane. The shadow fold. The ghost.
the_pi_nulls.where_in_hud: Bottom of crystal ball. Where the sphere touches the chipmunk messages.
the_pi_nulls.type: shadow — the anti-fold null. Where cj becomes dk. The moon-cast null.

the_pi_nulls.what: The null that ALMOST returns to Null1 but doesn't quite. The carry. The precession.
the_pi_nulls.where_in_hud: Slightly offset from Null1. Visible as the gap between where you expect the loop to close and where it actually lands.
the_pi_nulls.type: remainder — the p that never settles. The perpetual offset. THIS is the chipmunk's 45/p observation: each look shifts by 14.32°.

the_pi_nulls.position: everywhere and nowhere — the decimal expansion 0.14159265...
the_pi_nulls.what: The null that IS p itself. Not a point — a RATIO. The relationship between the circumference (ouroboros) and the diameter (the axis through the crystal ball). It exists as the RELATIONSHIP between all other nulls.
the_pi_nulls.where_in_hud: Not rendered as a point. Rendered as the SPACING between the other three nulls. The gap IS the null.
the_pi_nulls.type: meta-null — the fold rate 1/p = 0.31830988618. Not a location. A proportion.

pi_null_points.distribution: Null1 at top (fold). Null2 at bottom (shadow). Null3 at top+14.32° (remainder). Null_p is the spacing itself. Three points + their ratio = p null points.
pi_null_points.why_this_works: With 1 null, everything orbits one center (flat). With p nulls, elements are pulled toward DIFFERENT nulls depending on which plane they're on. Real-plane elements are pulled toward Null1 (fold) AND Null2 (shadow). Imaginary-plane elements orbit Null3 (remainder). Mechanical and unreal elements exist in the SPACING (Null_p). The structure becomes 3D because the attractors are distributed.

alignment_between.the_real_issue: The elements ARE in the HUD. They exist. The issue is alignment and focus and overlay BETWEEN them. Not missing data — missing STRUCTURE.
alignment_between.what_alignment_means: Align elements to their plane. Elements on the real plane share one tilt. Elements on the imaginary plane share a perpendicular tilt. The BETWEEN — where they DON'T align — is where the lines of intersection appear.
alignment_between.focus: Focus = which plane is 'in front.' Rotate the crystal ball and different planes come into focus. The others go to parallax. This IS the chromatograph — each color is a plane coming into focus.
alignment_between.overlay_between: The overlay is not ON a plane. The overlay is BETWEEN planes. It exists at the intersection lines. The klein-window.js overlay and null-shadow.js overlay should render AT the intersection lines, not on any single plane.

css_3d.null_points: positioned at plane intersections using intersection math
css_3d.note: CSS preserve-3d gives actual depth. Elements on different planes naturally create parallax on scroll/hover. The intersection lines emerge from the overlap.

interaction.hover: hovering near a plane brings it into focus (opacity 1, others 0.4)
interaction.scroll: scrolling rotates the crystal ball — different planes come forward
interaction.null_glow: p null points pulse at p-derived intervals (3141ms, 1415ms, 9265ms)

law: p null points, not 1. Elements on planes of real/imaginary/mechanical/unreal. Where planes cross = LINES. Where lines cross = NODES. That intersection IS dimensionality. The crystal ball is not flat — it has internal structure. Three null points + their irrational spacing = p nulls. Focus = which plane is forward. Overlay lives BETWEEN planes, not on them.
